Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan bowlers did really well with the new ball. Took 4 wickets before the first drinks break. Amir was excellent with his first spell and made Warner dance in the middle before putting him out of his misery. Hasan Ali was a bit expensive but bowled cleverly. Used change of pace to his strength and got 3 wickets for it. The spin duo of Wasim and Hafeez kept it tight by giving under 4 runs per over. Riaz and Nawaz were the other two bowlers used but both of them had an off day with the latter picking up a solo wicket. Join us shortly for the run chase!

Glenn Maxwell and Matthew Wade then steadied the ship as they stitched an 82-run partnership for the 6th wicket. The Big Show was looking in a good touch but he was undone by some smart piece of bowling by Hasan Ali. Faulkner then gifted his wicket. Wade, however, didn't stop fighting till the end and got involved in some good partnerships of 42, 23 and an unbeaten 33 runs with the tail. The Aussie keeper then went on to score his maiden century on the very last ball of the innings and take his side to a fighting total.

What a comeback from the Aussies! Thanks to a superb innings from their keeper, Matthew Wade! The hosts were pushed on the back foot early on as Mohammad Amir sent Warner and Smith packing in back-to-back deliveries in the 5th over. Lynn and Head looked to settle things down with the latter playing a run-a-ball 39! However, both of them along with Marsh fell in quick succession which got the hosts further into trouble.

Length delivery, angling away, Wade looks to play it across the line, gets square up and ends up getting a leading edge towards covers for a single. With this, Wade completes his MAIDEN ODI TON! What a knock it has been, take a bow! AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 268/9!
Back of a length delivery, pulled awkwardly near square leg. Wade comes back for the second and completes it as Hasan Ali fumbles to collect the throw at the striker's end. Moves to 99!
Another play and miss! Good use of slow ball by Hasan Ali!
Angling across Wade, he swings the bat but fails to make any contact.
FOUR! Full outside off, driven superbly through covers for a boundary.
Angling down the leg side, Wade looks to guide it on its way but is beaten by the lack of pace on it and is hit on the ribs!
On the pads, worked down the leg side behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven through widish mid on. Takes on the fielder in the deep. Stanlake uses his height to a great extent and dives full stretch to get back safely in!
Down the leg side, Wade shuffles across and looks to paddle it but misses it completely. There's some sound as the ball pass but not sure what it was of!
Full toss, Wade gets low and looks to flick but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Wide! Banged in short, Wade lets it sail through. Wide signalled for height!
FOUR! Length delivery, pulled through forward square leg for a boundary. Superb shot! Wade into his nineties!
Angling into the batsman, played with the angle to mid-wicket.

DECISION STAYS! Full outside off, angling away, Stanlake looks to play it with the angle but misses and the ball goes through to the keeper. There's a sound as the ball goes past Stanlake. Pakistan appeal but the umpire is unmoved. They review it. The replay shows that the sound was of the bat hitting the boot of the batsman.
Pakistan have taken the review for a caught behind decision given not out against Stanlake!
On the pads, BS looks to flick but misses and is hit low on the pads.
In the air... but safe! Back of a length delivery, Wade is surprised a bit and ends up miscuing it in the air but in the no man's land in the mid-wicket region. The batsmen run through for a single.

FOUR! Fires it full outside off, in the blockhole. Wade smartly nicks it purposely through the vacant slip region. Nawaz from third man look to cut it out with a dive but he too can't prevent it from reaching the fence. 250 up for the Aussies!
Slow bouncer, Wade gets beaten by the lack of pace!
FOUR! Full on the stumps, Wade just lofts it over mid-wicket. The ball goes one bounce into the stands. That's just a clean hit!
The batsman has dug out that yorker at the last second.
Full and outside off, pushed towards the off side. The batsmen go for the quick single and the fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Stanlake had lost his bat there!
SIX! BRUTAL! What a shot. A short ball on middle, Wade jumps down the track and pulls it massively over mid-wicket for a massive hit! That is not a short boundary over there.
Full on middle, chipped past the bowler down the ground. Mid on does well to get across and slide to stop the batsmen to a single.
Full toss outside off, pushed down to deepish mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, driven powerfully but straight to mid off.

A full toss on the pads, swinging back in, Billy misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls back to the bowler who throws it back at the stumps. Stanlake would have been a goner as he did not get back in.Excellent over from Hasan - 2 runs and a wicket from it. His figures read - 7-0-49-3.
Full and just outside off, Stanlake pushes at it but the ball nips past the outside edge.
Debutant BILLY STANLAKE is the last man in. Can he hang around with Wade till the 50th over?

OUT! Bowled! Another slower one! This is around middle, on a length, Starc looks to work it to the leg side but misses. The ball hits the timber. Waste of a wicket from Starc. Could have helped Australia to a bigger total. Hasan gets his third wicket.
A lovely slower ball, on a length on middle, Starc heaves but misses. The ball goes over the stumps.
On middle and leg, heaved through mid-wicket for a run.
A full toss on middle, bunted past the bowler towards long on for a single. Moves to 10 from 6 balls.
HASAN ALI comes back on to bowl.
A yorker outside off, MS just about digs it out back to the bowler. Amir leaps but parries it to long on. A single taken. The stand moves to 21 from 13 balls.

SIX! Could that have been taken? Perhaps. A short ball around off, Starc cannot resist himself and goes for the pull. Seems like he has miscued it and Sharjeel Khan gets across to his right at the mid-wicket fence. But all of a sudden, he gives it up. The ball lands just beyond him, almost on the ropes! He could have caught it had he stayed behind, but then the sun might have come into his eyes. The 'Gabba crowd gives him a bit of its own. Meanwhile, Amir and Starc have a contest of their own.
A short ball around middle, tucked uppishly towards deep backward square leg for a run.
A low full toss outside off, pushed off the toe end of the bat towards mid off.
Outside off, pushed towards mid off. Mitchell lumbers for a run, almost like an evening jog, could have been in trouble but the fielder fumbles. An easy single in the end.

ALMOST! Full on middle, Starc looks to tuck it to the leg side but ends up chipping it in the air. "CATCH!" is the call but Mohammad Nawaz slips while trying to go forward. The ball lands in front anyways but Amir feels that Nawaz could have done better there.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A slower bouncer outside off, Wade pulls it with total control through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Lucky escape. A short ball on middle, Wade looks to pull but gets a top edge which goes over the keeper to the fine leg fence!
Shorter in length this time, cut straight to point again. Wade is frustrated and lets out an "AARGGGHHHHHHHHH!!!"
Outside off, played straight to point.

FOUR! Oh that is a terrific shot. Wade once again gets across his stumps, looking to paddle but Wahab does well to bowl it outside off and cramp him for room. But the Victorian does well to pull it past short fine leg for a boundary! He almost loses his balance but manages to recover in time. Moves to 62 from 73 balls with his second boundary.
FREE HIT COMING UP!

NO BALL! WHOA! That will not please Wade who is struggling with his back and this heat. He is standing across his stumps and Wahab bowls a beamer just outside off. Wade just sees it at the last second, is surprised, tries to play the late cut but misses.
WAHAB RIAZ is back on. Pakistan need to nip these two wickets out quickly.
Down the leg side, tucked towards fine leg for a single. So Amir gets a wicket, albeit in a different fashion.
MITCHELL STARC comes in at number 10, replacing Cummins. Wade will be on strike. Still 43 balls left. Can the Aussies play out their 50 overs? Wade and Starc have a longgggggggggggggg chat.

OUT! Cummins is run out! Don't quite know why Cummins did not run! He pushed it towards point and took a bit of a start. But then he stopped on seeing Umar Akmal get to the ball. Wade had no issues and kept on running and Cummins had no go than to sacrifice his wicket. Umar lobs the throw back to the bowler who runs towards the stumps and takes the bails off. Easy run out. End of a sensible stand of 42 from 53 balls.
WIDE. A bouncer short and down the leg side, Pat ducks.
A short ball outside off, PC looks to pull but misses.
A short ball on middle, Cummins pulls this over mid-wicket. Babar Azam covers good ground to his left in the deep and keeps the batsmen to a couple. The stand moves to 41 from 51 balls.
On a good length around middle, tapped towards point.
A short ball on middle, Wade pulls this ferociously but straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR comes back on. Pat Cummins calls for a helmet while Wade calls for a drink and helmet.
Full on middle and leg, swept away for another run. 13 from that over, compensates a touch for 2 in the previous one for Australia.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
Short and down the leg side, Matthew sits down and pull-sweeps this over square leg for a single.
Flicks it through mid-wicket and hares back for the second again.
Comes down the track and chips it over mid-wicket for a couple.
11th ODI Fifty for Matthew Wade, first against Pakistan!

SIX! Just over! Wade dances down the track and Nawaz floats this wide outside off. For a second, it seems like Wade would get stumped. But the next second, the ball flies over the leaping long on fielder to clear the ropes. A very crucial half century. Can he take Australia to the 50-over mark? Don't worry about the score if he lasts the distance. 200 UP FOR AUSTRALIA! The stand moves to 31 from 43 balls. Healthy.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Very full outside off, driven hard down the ground but Wasim leaps to stop.
Driven towards the long off region. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, chipped down to long off for a single.

POWERPLAY 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders allowed outside the circle. Suspect Pakistan will be happy with keeping 5 inside rather. They would want Australia to get bowled out quickly. 250-260 could be defended at this venue.
Full outside off, Cummins extends his arms and drives it through to long off for a single. 193/7 AT THE END OF 40 OVERS!

DROPPED! Shortish delivery, sliding in, Cummins looks to punch it off the back foot but ends up outside edging it. The ball goes quickly towards Hafeez at first slip, who fails to hold onto it. Can that prove to be costly?
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
On the pads, worked fine down the leg side but there's a man present there.
Tossed up around off, Wade uses his feet and whips it through mid-wicket. The long on fielder cuts it out and the batsmen run through for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Cummins leans into the shot and drives it through covers. Hasan Ali from mid off does the covering up. The batsman picks up a brace.
Shortish outside off, rises on Wade a touch, he flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and flatter on leg, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Shortish delivery, sliding further away, turned to mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Around leg, Cummins looks to play it across the line but the ball turns away a touch, brushes the thigh on its way to third man. A leg bye is taken!
Darts it in on middle and leg, Cummins does well to block it.
IMAD WASIM is back on!
Served outside off, Cummins pushes the ball with a high back lift through mid off for a single.
Around middle, Cummins gets squared up as the ball turns away a bit. Goes off the outside edge past first slip towards third man. A couple is taken!
Outside off, sliding into the stumps, tapped back to the bowler.
Once again Wade uses his feet and eases it to long on for a single.
Outside off, Cummins drives it off the front foot through mid off for a single.
Outside off, Wade dances down the track and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Going down leg, Cummins works it straight to square leg.
Angling into the pads, played to mid-wicket.
Once again Wade uses his feet, turns it through widish mid on. Azhar from short mid-wicket charges in and hurls a throw at the non-striker's end on the dive but misses. A single is completed!
Tossed up outside off, Wade gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it near the surface.
Angling into the stumps, defended off the back foot.
Sliding into the pads, driven through mid on for a single.
Full outside off, eased through to long off for a single.
Outside off, angling in, defended to mid off.
Once again it's pushed straight back to the bowler.
Landed on middle and off, driven straight back.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Sliding into the pads, played to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot through mid on for a single. The ball bounced on him a touch there!
On middle and leg, eased through to long for a single.
Full outside off, driven straight to extra cover.
PAT CUMMINS walks in, replacing Faulkner!

OUT! FAULKNER GIFTS HIS WICKET! Outside off, Faulkner stays back and guides it late. But, straight to Hafeez at first slip, who does well to hold on to it. That's poor awareness from Faulkner! Australia have 3 wickets in hand with 16 overs still to go!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Again Wade does the same thing and this time is successful in finding the gap at mid-wicket. Earns himself a single!
Outside off, Wade gets to the pitch of the ball and turns it to Wasim at short mid-wicket.
Served on middle and leg, flicked gently through mid-wicket for a single.
Faulkner uses his feet, gets forward a touch and blocks the ball on the bounce on the off side.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ is back on!
On middle, Faulkner drives it through mid on for a single. He will retain the strike.
On the boots, clipped straight to square leg.
Angling into the pads, defended with the angle to mid-wicket.
Lands it near the boots, eased through to long on for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Slides it down the leg side. James leaves it alone. Wide is signaled!
Tossed up on the pads, worked on the leg side for a single.
MOHAMMAD HAFEEZ is back on.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Length delivery on the stumps, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone.
Slower one outside off, gently guides it through to backward point for a quick single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, cut into the ground to backward point.

Time for drinks! Australia lost Marsh just after the first drinks break. But, Maxwell and Wade pulled it back for Australia. However, just on brink of drinks, Maxwell was undone by a change of pace from Hasan Ali. JAMES FAULKNER is the new man to walk in!

OUT! BIG BLOW! MAXI'S GONE! Slower one does the trick once again for Hasan. Bowls an off cutter, Maxwell is early into his shot as he looks to whip it. Mistimes it high in the air and Hafeez takes a simple catch at mid-wicket. That's a big, big wicket as Maxwell can prove to be lethal in the last overs. Good piece of bowling by Hasan, breaks the 82-run partnership!
Banged in short, Maxwell goes for a hook but gets a top edge over the keeper's head towards long stop. A couple taken!
Fullish outside off, driven on the up to mid off, where the fielder grabs the ball and immediately hurls a throw at the non-striker's end but misses his shy as Wade dives back in.
Angling into the pads, defended to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Smashed that! Length delivery outside off, Maxwell latches onto it in a flash and pulls it through widish mid on for a boundary.
Wide! Banged in short, Maxwell leaves it alone. The ball sails over his head and the square leg umpire signals it as a wide for height.
Length delivery outside off, tapped on the up to covers.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
The batsman plays the pull shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Appeal for a catch! Turned down, WIDE signalled instead! Riaz wants the review but Azhar Ali says there is no edge. Short and down the leg side, Maxwell looks to pull but misses. Replays show that there was no edge.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ is back on.
A short ball on middle, Wade looks to pull but misses and is hit on the tummy.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On a length on middle, punched to deep point for a run.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
14th ODI Fifty for Maxwell, 3rd vs Pakistan! The Big Show is back!
There is his half century! A short ball, pulled away for a single. The crowd rises in appreciation. Can they get a big knock from the Big Show?
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
Full on middle, Maxi comes down the track and clips it through mid-wicket, this time all along the ground, for a single.
Full and around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.

ALMOST A CATCH! Lovely bowling. Flights this up to invite Maxi to have a go at him but then slows the pace slyly as Maxwell does exactly that. The result is that he looks to chip but ends up hitting it a bit too well. Substitute Asad Shafiq comes running in from long off and dives but cannot get to the ball. A single taken.
Full and outside off, defended back to the bowler.

FOUR! BRUTAL! He really does get a lot of power behind the shot. Full on middle, Maxwell gets down and reverse-slogs this over point. Nearly goes all the way! One bounce and into the fence. The stand moves to 61 from 65 balls.
Full and outside off, Matthew drives it on the up, with superb timing, straight to mid off.
Full and straight, driven straight back. Hasan does well to stop it.

"YEAH, MATE! TWO, TWO, TWO!" was the call from Wade as soon as he hit it. Down the leg side, he tucked it in front of square on the leg side and charged back for the second. The throw came in to the bowler who deflected it onto the stumps and appealed for a run out, but it turned out to be a no show to try and run out the Big Show.
A lovely shot. Short ball around off, Maxwell swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for one. The good thing about that shot was that he kept the ball down.
Similar ball, Wade follows suit, helping the ball to fine leg for a run. Moves to 20 from 32 balls.
A length ball on middle, tucked through square leg for a single.
HASAN ALI comes back on to bowl.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square.
Comes down the track and just chips it over the bowler towards long on for a single.
50-run stand is up in 56 balls!
FOUR! BOSH! Full on middle, Maxwell brings out his reverse sweep and slogs it over point for a boundary!
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Comes down a touch and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

LBW shout, but the bowler is not interested. Nor the umpire. Full on middle and leg, Wade leans to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Rizwan shouts an appeal but no one else is bothered. That looked close. One could see the leg stump when Wade got hit. The ball went to square leg and Maxwell wanted the single but was sent back. The Big Show is disappointed. He is on the move here, wants as much strike as possible.

FOUR! Terrific batting. Full and on middle, Maxwell gets down and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket. He wanted to go over the top but ended up dragging it. Got a boundary nevertheless. 11 from the over.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Excellent running. Glenn works this through mid-wicket and Wade supports him well to come back for the second.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Full on middle, Maxwell gets down and sweeps it over square leg for a boundary!  Moves to 30 from 32 balls with his third boundary. The stand is worth 40 from 49 balls.
A touch shorter, around off, Matthew ticks it towards mid-wicket. Mohammad Nawaz gets across to his left and attempts to throw while sliding but misses the ball. Just a single taken.
Full and outside off, Wade lunges and presents an exaggerated forward defense towards cover.
Short and outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, Wade lunges to defend but gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg.
Oohhh... chips this uppishly over mid on, towards long on but luckily for him, the ball does not carry. A single taken.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to point.
Cover goes back now.

FOUR! Welcome into the attack, mate! Full and outside off, a bit of width, Maxwell comes forward and greets him with just a push over cover. The timing is exquisite and it lands and then races into the fence! The stand moves to 33 from 41 balls.
Finally, MOHAMMAD NAWAZ has been given the ball.
Full and outside off, defended watchfully.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
On middle and off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full on middle and leg, tucked behind square leg for a single.
Landed on middle, worked towards square leg this time.
Full on the pads, flicked straight to short mid-wicket. The throw is a wild one, past the keeper but backward point backs it up.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
FOUR! Edged away! Full and outside off, Wade looks to drive but gets a healthy outside edge which flies past first slip to third man!
Landed outside off, punched off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Massive inside edge. Full and outside off, Wade looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Amir appeals for LBW and the umpire raises his finger! Wade immediately takes the review and nods towards Maxwell on the inside edge. Replays and Hot Spot confirm the same.
Matthew Wade has been adjudged LBW! He takes the review instantaneously.
Finds the gap nicely. Landed on middle, Maxwell goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a couple. The stand is worth 20 from 28 balls.
Comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, worked through square leg for a run. Moves to 10 from 15 balls.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, Maxwell leans and drives it uppishly but wide of cover for a single.
It is pretty warm out there. The batsmen take a break and Maxwell changes his gloves as well.
Fullish delivery outside off, Maxwell drives it on the up through covers for a single. 94/5 AFTER 20 OVERS!
Fuller on the boots, clipped through to fine leg for a single.
Fired in full on middle and off, Wade does extremely well to flick it through mid-wicket and pick up a brace.
On the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Angling into the pads, Wade flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery, angling in, defended from within the crease.
Azhar Ali going for the kill. MOHAMMAD AMIR has been brought back. If he breaks this stand, this could get over all too quickly for Australia.
Tossed up on the stumps, driven through widish mid on. The mid-wicket fielder cuts it off and gives away no runs.
Short delivery, Glenn camps back and taps it back to the bowler.

RUN OUT CHANCE! On middle, Wade gently works it just in front of square on the leg side. Umar Akmal gets to the ball in a flash and hurls a throw at the striker's end. However, Rizwan fails to collect the ball cleanly and the chance goes begging. A single is completed! Had it been a direct hit, Maxwell was a goner!
Arm ball, sliding away from the southpaw, punched off the back foot but straight to covers.
Landed outside off, Wade prods forward in defence.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight back. Wasim fails to stop it with his dive on the left and the batsmen run through for a single.
On a length and angling away, Maxi gets on his toes and punches through covers for a single. Will retain the strike!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angling into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Wade gets on his toes, opens the face of his bat and guides it to backward point.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Wade leaves it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Outside off, angling away further, Maxwell uses the angle and directs it through to third man for a single.
Outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Another sweep through backward square leg for a single.
Sliding into the pads, played with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, swept through backward square leg for a single. Off the mark straightaway!
MATTHEW WADE walks in at no. 7!

OUT! WASIM HAS ANOTHER IN HIS BAG! Marsh fails to get his team out of trouble! Served around off, spins away a touch. Marsh looks to punch off the back foot as he thinks it's another arm ball. But, the ball spins away a touch. Catches the outside edge on its way and Rizwan takes another sharp catch. Good bowling and good wicket-keeping! AUS deep into trouble now.
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.

Drinks break! Successful period for the Men in Green as they have seen the backs of 4 Aussie batsmen. Warner was put out of his misery by Amir while the skipper followed his opening batsman, immediately on the next ball. Lynn failed to continue his Australian domestic T20 form. Head looked the most comfortable of the lot but Wasim got the better of him. Marsh and Maxwell are out in the middle. Will they carry their side out of trouble?
Length delivery on the stumps, defended from within the crease to covers.
On off and angling away, Marsh shoulders his arms.
On the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single.
Great comeback from Riaz! Back of a length delivery around off, Glenn looks to defend it off the back foot with a straight bat but the ball angles away a touch, whizzing past the outside edge.
FOUR! On a length and outside off, angling away further, Maxwell slaps it powerfully past the backward point fielder. The ball reaches the fence in a flash. Good shot that!
Length delivery on off, seams back in a touch, Maxwell hops and plays it through widish mid on for no run.
WAHAB RIAZ is back into the attack!
Short and around middle, punched towards the bowler. Just 2 from the over, only 11/1 in the last 5. Pakistan have pulled things back remarkably.
Short and straight, punched towards long on for a single.
In the air... but past the bowler. Wasim holds this up, outside off, Mitchell drives this loosely and uppishly, just wide of the bowler towards long off for a single.
Shorter in length, punched towards mid on again.
Slower through the air, outside off, pushed towards point.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angling into Maxwell, turned with the angle to mid-wicket.
Maxwell looks to play with the angle on the leg side but gets it off the leading half of the bat back to the bowler.
OFF THE MARK! Full outside off, Maxwell makes some room and slices it through cover-point for a brace.
Sliding into the pads, played towards mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot through mid on for a single.
GLENN MAXWELL is the new man in! Can he change his team's fortune?

OUT! WASIM STRIKES! HEAD DEPARTS! Another arm ball around off, Head looks to drive it off the front foot but is late on his shot. There's a faint nick and Rizwan takes a sharp catch behind the stumps. Another tight over by Wasim and a successful one! AUS in deep, deep trouble now!
Outside off, Marsh drives it through mid off for a single.
Angling into the pads, Marsh goes for a wild flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.

Served around off, Head reads it wrong and looks to turn it on the on side with the spin. But, it's an arm ball and Head gets squared up. The leading edge takes the ball through backward point for a single.

Outside off, angling further away, Head is beaten in his shot and Rizwan collects the ball and takes the bails off in a flash. Appeals for a stumping but the square leg umpire says not out. Replays show that Head was back in his crease before the bails were disturbed.
Sliding away from the southpaw, Head guides it late but it's straight to short third man.
Tossed up outside off, Head uses his feet a touch and drives it to long off for a single.
Slider, Head goes back, but gets cramped for room and then plays it back to the bowler.
On the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Served fuller outside off, Head leans and drives it straight to covers.
Fuller on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single. With that, Marsh gets off the mark!
Short delivery, punched off the back foot to long off for a single.
Spin from both ends as MOHAMMAD HAFFEZ is brought back on!
Short and wide outside off, Marsh looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge into the ground. Good tight over by Wasim. Just one from it!
Tossed up on middle and off, Marsh goes back and plays it with a straight bat through mid on. The mid-wicket fielder gets across to field. No runs taken!
Fuller outside off, pushed through mid off. Wasim moves to his left and fields the ball and gives away nothing.
On the stumps, played straight back off the back foot.
BEATEN! That's the first ball Marsh has faced. Straighter one outside off, Marsh waits and looks to play it late but misses it completely.
On middle and off, going away from the southpaw with the angle, played off the back foot through covers for a single.
IMAD WASIM comes into the attack now.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. Four fielders allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.

Outside off, slashed down to third man for a run. 9 runs and a wicket from the over. Hasan Ali's figures read 3-0-30-1 so far. Has copped some stick but broke the threatening stand. AUSTRALIA ARE 62/3 IN THE POWERPLAY.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! PRISTINE! Full and wide outside off, Head shows his classical side this time as he drives this through the covers for consecutive boundaries!
Hasan changes the angle now, comes around the wicket.

FOUR! How is that for a counter-punch? Full and wide outside off, Head leans and crashes it through the covers for a boundary! His last 10 balls have yielded 22 runs for Head. Mostly through the region in front of square on the off side.
MITCHELL MARSH walks in at number 5, replacing Lynn.

OUT! Caught! Hasan Ali strikes! Poor batting now, from Lynn. The confidence got to him. He was perhaps thinking that this is the last over of the Mandatory Powerplay and wanted to take full toll but got outsmarted. Hasan changed the pace, bowling at 119.8 kph, Lynn tried to slog it across but failed to read the slower one. Got a top edge which balooned to the leg side and Mohammad Rizwan took it running a bit to his left. Promised a lot but it was a short stay from Lynn. End of a quickfire stand of 39 from 28 balls.
Full and outside off, Lynn backs away, aiming to punch it through the off side but is not close to the pitch of the ball and ends up hitting it back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat.
Landed around off, watchfully defended. 14 from the over.
Short and outside off, cut again, this time Umar Akmal gets across from point to his left to stop the ball.
FOUR! Three in a row! Short and wide outside off once again, Head cuts it through point for another boundary! Poor bowling from Riaz. 50 UP FOR AUSTRALIA!
FOUR! Short again, wide as well, this time Head cuts it through point for a boundary again!
FOUR! Short and outside off, Head stands tall and punches it through the covers for a boundary!

A short ball around middle, Chris pulls this uppishly towards deep square leg. Mohammad Nawaz gets to the ball from deep mid-wicket, returns the throw slowly to the keeper who collides with Umar Akmal who was at the stumps for backing up the throw. The throw was anyways over the players and both were not happy with Nawaz.
WIDE. A short ball around middle and leg, too high, Lynn ducks. Wided for height.
WAHAB RIAZ to bowl now.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.

FOUR RUNNING RUNS! Anyone for Dog and the Bone? Funny piece of fielding. Full on middle, Head flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket. Mohammad Nawaz and Mohammad Hafeez chase it in pair, with the former getting to the ball and sliding to pull it back in. Now here is where the game starts. Hafeez gets to the ball but then expects his junior to throw the ball. Nawaz, on the other hand, gives respect to his senior and lets him take it. So, in the end, it is like, who has to throw anyway? Hafeez does the honours and the batsmen run all four.
Full on middle and leg, flicked straight to mid on.
Full and outside off, pushed wide of mid off for a couple. Moves to 10 from 17 balls and this stand is worth 21 from 17 balls.
Outside off, punched wide of mid off for a single.

SIX! BOOM! There it comes! Cricket enthusiasts saw plenty of this in the Australian Domestic T20 League. Fractionally short and outside off, Lynn just swats it on the up, over mid-wicket for a biggie! Does not bother to look where the ball went. Moves to 14 from 8 balls.
Good length, just around off, angling in, defended solidly.
Short and outside off, punched straight to Akmal at cover-point.

That is a fabulous shot. On a length outside off, Lynn just stands and punches this through the covers. Umar Akmal chases it from point, slides and gets to the ball. The batsmen take two and then the third, on the throw.

Cramps him for room as Travis looks to tuck it to the leg side. The ball goes off the inside edge and drops near him but Head searches for the ball. Meanwhile, Lynn calls for the single and Amir runs to collect but Lynn comes in his way and Amir has to abort.
Landed around off, angling in, punched firmly towards cover.
On a good length around off, Head plays it as late as possible and defends.

This one comes right back into Lynn who looks to flick but misses. Rizwan dives to  his left and appeals for the catch but the umpire turns it down while the bowler is not even interested. One of our scorers says he heard a noise, might have been the thigh pad. Sharp ears, that. I did not hear anything. Or may be my hearing is a bit poor.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
WIDE. A bouncer on middle, Lynn lets it sail through. Too high and wided.

FOUR RUNNING RUNS! Full and wide outside off, Lynn throws his bat at it and hits it uppishly, towards cover. Mohammad Hafeez dives to his right and gets a hand to it. Azhar Ali chases it from mid off and gets to the ball, tries to slide and push the ball back but slips. In the end, returns the throw but the batsmen run all four.
Down the leg side, tucked towards fine leg for one.
Short and outside off, punched wide of mid off for a run. His first in ODIs.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
HASAN ALI comes into the attack. Mohammad Hafeez is off, as Warner is gone now.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. What an over from Amir - 2 runs and 2 wickets from it.
Lovely delivery for a hat-trick ball. Full and swinging in, perhaps a shade too straight, Lynn flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
The crowd roars as local lad CHRIS LYNN walks in at number 4, replacing his skipper. What a moment for the debutant. Coming in to face the hat-trick ball!

OUT! Another big wicket! Two in two for Amir as Smith goes for a golden duck! Really, a poor shot from the skipper. Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Smith is walking into his shot already, with his feet not that much to the pitch of the ball. Gets an outside edge which is calmly taken by Rizwan. That is the way he plays. When he gets it for a boundary through the covers it looks beautiful. Else, it looks ugly. Quack quack for the skipper.
Australian skipper STEVEN SMITH walks in at number 3, replacing Warner.

OUT! BOWLED! Warner is back on strike and now he is back in the pavillion! He was trying this in the last over and finally hits the mark. His celebrations show that. Amir was trying to angle the ball into Warner and then make it to go away off the seam. He landed this on leg stump, Warner tried to flick but missed it, playing all around it. Normally the ball should have gone past the leg stump with the angle but then the ball seamed away to hit the leg stump! Big, big wicket.
Wrote too soon. A length ball down the leg side, Head tucks it towards backward square leg for a run. His bottom hand came off the bat there. Warner is back on strike.

That is a good single. Especially for Warner. He was continuously being troubled by Amir and will be happy to get off strike for some time. Full and outside off, Warner leans and drives it through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, defended watchfully towards cover.
Down the leg side, short as well, tucked towards short fine leg for a quick single.
Another change in the field. Mid-wicket drops back now. Perhaps mid off might have come up.

FOUR! There he goes, making use of the change in field. Comes down the track, probably eyeing to go over mid on but the ball is on the pads and he whips it over mid-wicket. Not quite his proper flick shot, ends up dragging it but is hit well enough to clear the infield over mid-wicket and beat the fielder running after it from mid on.
Mid off drops back for Warner now while mid on comes in.
Comes forward a touch and pushes it past the bowler towards long on for a single.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, gets away with it, cut straight to point.

Yes, that is the length. But what a poor choice of a shot. Warner is getting frustrated. Full and outside off, Warner tries a ridiculous flick across the line and misses the ball completely. So far was he from the ball that it was nowhere close to the edge.

A play and a miss. On a good length outside off, DW feels for it but the ball seams away and bounces to beat him. That is a good delivery. Came in with the angle then seamed away. Probably he needs to be a tad fuller.
Outside off, steered behind point for a run.
Ooohhh.... this one comes back in as well, David looks to tuck it away but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards fine leg. Warner finally gets off the mark on his 12th ball.
This one nips back in, Warner tucks it towards square leg.
Short and outside off, Head slashes this uppishly behind point for a single.
Full and straight, driven back to the bowler. Warner stays on 0.
Comes down the track, gets it on the full and drives it but straight to point.
Fuller and around leg, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Short and around off, punched straight to cover.
Another nice juicy full toss, driven powerfully down to deepish mid off for a single for the first run of the bat for Australia.
A full toss on middle, Head goes leg side of the ball and drives it straight to cover.
Interesting. MOHAMMAD HAFEEZ to bowl with the other new ball.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly but straight to Imad Wasim at short cover.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Warner lets it go. Good carry through to Rizwan.
Landed around off, pushed towards mid off.
Very good line and length, full and just around off, swinging away a touch, DW defends watchfully.
Ahh.... this is short and outside off, David sees the width, goes after it, slashing hard but misses.
That is a lovely ball. Right on the spot. Full and around middle, swinging away, Warner covers the line but still gets squared up a touch. Manages to push it towards cover.
The players are out in the middle. A lefty-lefty combination to start off as DAVID WARNER and TRAVIS HEAD take their place in the centre. MOHAMMAD AMIR to begin the proceedings with the ball.
PAKISTAN PLAYING XI - Azhar Ali(C), Mohammad Rizwan(WK), Mohammad Hafeez, Wahab Riaz, Umar Akmal, Mohammad Amir, Imad Wasim, Sharjeel Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Babar Azam, Hasan Ali.
AUSTRALIA PLAYING XI - Steven Smith(C), Matthew Wade(WK), James Faulkner, David Warner, Mitchell Starc, Chris Lynn, Glenn Maxwell, Mitchell Marsh, Pat Cummins, Billy Stanlake, Travis Head.
TOSS - Australia have WON the toss and elected to BAT FIRST.

Hello and a warm welcome to the opening ODI between Australia and Pakistan. The hosts dominated the Test series whitewashing the visitors. They have already announced their playing XI which means that Chris Lynn and Billy Stanlake make their ODI debuts. Pakistan will look to redeem themselves in the limited overs' format after a dismal performance in the Tests. They will also have one eye on the automatic qualification for WC 2019. The hosts are favourites but if the Men in Green step up, we are in for a cracker of a contest at the 'Gabba.
